title: Business Center Services Card — Bluegate Business Storage Account Programs
content:
Bluegate Business Storage Account holders have use of the facility business center according to their program. The card sets out the conference room hours included each calendar month, the hourly fee beyond them, and whether business center Wi-Fi and letter mail handling into a secured mailbox are included.

| Program | Conference room hours included per calendar month | Fee per hour beyond the included hours | Business center Wi-Fi | Letter mail sorted into a secured mailbox |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Business Essentials | 0 | $15.00 | Not included | Not included |
| Bluegate Business Plus | 2 | $15.00 | Included | Not included |
| Bluegate Business Pro | 4 | $12.00 | Included | Included |
| Bluegate Business Logistics | 4 | $12.00 | Included | Included |
| Bluegate Business Fleet | 2 | $15.00 | Included | Not included |
| Bluegate Business National Account | 10 | $10.00 | Included | Included |

**About the conference room hours.** The included hours are a monthly allowance and are counted per calendar month. On Bluegate Business Essentials no hours are included, so every hour of use is beyond the allowance and charged at $15.00.

**Monthly illustrations (hypothetical usage).**

| Program | Hours used in the month | Included | Hours beyond | Charge |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Business Essentials | 3 | 0 | 3 | 3 at $15.00, $45.00 |
| Bluegate Business Plus | 2 | 2 | 0 | $0.00 |
| Bluegate Business Pro | 6 | 4 | 2 | 2 at $12.00, $24.00 |
| Bluegate Business National Account | 12 | 10 | 2 | 2 at $10.00, $20.00 |
